findings.text: follow-on: the head gate log was produced with -q -rs, which prints no FAILED summary lines, so the added-failure derivation reads 0 on both arms against a manifest that records 33 head failures and the log cannot support an added-failure measurement.

follow-on: the base arm ran with --timeout=60 and the head arm with --timeout=20, so they were not run the same way as the done_when states, and the head arm's failures are pytest-timeout at >20.0s (head-arm-full.log:2559) while failure_attribution asserts >60s, so the claim that none is caused by the change is not established by the arm pair.

item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to resolve the installed Playwright headless shell in the browser harness; tests/spa_browser_harness.py:573 rewrites installed_browser() to try RECKON_BROWSER at :576, then the three PATH names at :580, then the Playwright shell at :583, so the shell is found when it is the only browser installed.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log reddens the two resolution checks in tests/test_browser_harness_finds_playwright.py when the Playwright clause is removed, so a guard for the clause exists, though the skip-message check passes under the mutation and guards nothing about the clause.
justifications.evidence: head-arm-full.log:2620 records 33 failed/35 passed and 0 skipped at c2c060c and base-arm.log:63 records 66 skips at fef8ae2da, but the base arm ran with --timeout=60 against the head arm's --timeout=20 and neither log carries FAILED lines, so the added-failure comparison the done_when asks for is not established.
justifications.fit: playwright_browsers_root at tests/spa_browser_harness.py:538 follows the surrounding shutil.which idiom and introduces no plan label or version name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/spa_browser_harness.py:573 resolves RECKON_BROWSER, then the PATH names at :580, then the Playwright headless shell at :583, and the skip message at :595 names every location, so the node goal is met.
justifications.reuse: installed_browser() at tests/spa_browser_harness.py:573 is the existing owner of browser resolution and the change extends it; a search of tests/ and reckon/ for chrome-headless-shell, ms-playwright and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH found no other resolution to duplicate.
